description: Wavefolder: the input is amplified until it folds back on itself, up to six times, with an offset that makes the folding uneven; polyphonic, following the channel count of the input

params.text: Sets the gain applied to the signal before folding, 0 to 14, and the higher the gain the more times the signal folds back
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the fold modulation input, which is added to the fold knob; at full travel each volt there adds one to the gain
Offsets the signal before folding, -1 to +1, so the folds fall unevenly either side of zero
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the symmetry modulation input, which is added to the symmetry knob; at full travel 5V there covers the knob's whole range
Sets how many folding passes are applied, 2, 4 or 6; the alternative folding algorithm on the menu does its folding in one pass and ignores this switch

inputs.text: The signal to fold, read as ±5V and scaled to ±1 before the gain; a polyphonic cable is folded channel by channel
Adds to the fold knob through its attenuverter, and it tracks audio rate as well as CV
Adds to the symmetry knob through its attenuverter, and it tracks audio rate as well as CV

outputs.text: The folded signal, run through a tanh curve and scaled back to ±5V, with the channel count of the input

notes: the folding runs at four times the sample rate, and the resampling shifts the phase of the output slightly against the input
menu: Alternative folding algorithm — folds in a single pass instead of repeated passes, which makes the stages switch do nothing and changes how the symmetry knob behaves
